script: Start with a simple shape, then add a stem and a couple of leaves. Give each piece its own timing. You can move the whole group while the details keep moving on their own. Bring the scenes together, add a little sound, and it's ready to share.
runtime: Committed WAV assets. No network, service account, TTS package or speech provider required to use the sample.
releaseStatus: Provider output permissions remain part of the unfinished public-release audit.
